episodes.title: The Note Between
episodes.caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 1: The Note Between. A keeper finds a fading light whose note clashes with his; he goes to find the note between — a flat, an outsider — and it holds them together.  the more you know, the more you observe.

episodes.title: The Conversation
episodes.caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 2: The Conversation. Two notes meet and speak in their notes. When they sing together, the world remembers it was once a song — and the Silence loses one step of ground.  the more you know, the more you observe.
